# Southwest Stucco Inc.

> Family-owned stucco and plastering contractor in Calabasas, California, serving Los Angeles homeowners and builders since 1995. Commercial and residential stucco, scaffold installation, smooth/sand/acrylic finishes, stucco repair. CSLB License #702110.

## About

Southwest Stucco Inc. is a family-owned and operated stucco contractor headquartered in Calabasas, California. Founded in 1995, the same family has run every job for over 30 years. We specialize in commercial and residential stucco application, scaffold installation, custom finishes (smooth, sand, acrylic), interior plaster, and stucco repair and patching across greater Los Angeles.

## Services

- Commercial stucco — apartment complexes, offices, retail
- Residential stucco and plastering
- Scaffold installation and management
- Stucco repair and patching (cracks, water damage, earthquake remediation, match-and-patch)
- Smooth finish
- Sand finish
- Acrylic finish
- Custom finishes — interior or exterior

## Why Customers Choose Us

- Family owned & operated — talk directly to the owners, not a franchise
- Show up on time, every time
- Visible quality — every finish is one we'll put our name on
- Always reachable — we pick up the phone and respond quickly
- Fair, honest, transparent pricing — no surprise charges or hidden fees
- 30+ years of trust — most new work comes from word-of-mouth referrals
